hypothesis: Table user_preferences was created without Row Level Security enabled. Granting table-level access allows PostgREST Data API to serve sensitive contextual user preferences to unauthenticated queries.

Table trip_capsule_entries lacks explicit GRANT statements in its creation migration. When rebuilt in fresh environments after October 30 without automatic default grants, PostgREST queries fail with 42501 permission denied.
View user_trips_view lacks explicit GRANT SELECT to API roles. Recreating the view in environments without inherited default privileges causes PostgREST to reject view queries.

A naive migration static analysis scanner inspecting CREATE TABLE statements fails to differentiate Cloudflare D1 SQLite schemas from PostgreSQL schemas, producing false positive build rejections on valid SQLite files.
